item.title: India Highlights 6G and Quantum Communications as Technology Priorities
item.summary: Insider Brief India has an opportunity to create an impact in sixth-generation (6G) technology, quantum communications, and quantum security, Minister of State for Communications Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani said on Tuesday, speaking at the 43rd foundation day of the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DoT). “We have the opportunity to impact 6G, rather than just reading […]
